newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: MEDIENOS PLAUSHAS GETS $3.8 MLN LOAN.
newsitem.headline: MEDIENOS PLAUSHAS GETS $3.8 MLN LOAN.

text.p: The Lithuanian Development Bank and Vilniaus Bank said on Wednesday that they had issued the country's first joint loan for $3.8 to cardboard maker Medienos Plaushas.
The banks said in a statement that the annual interest rate is LIBOR + four percent. The maturity is seven years.
The share of each bank is $1.9 million.
The banks said that their joint effort reduced the risks to each bank while increasing the amount of credit available.
The loan will be used by the company to acquire new production lines.
Medienos Plaushas is one of Lithuania's top blue chip companies and is one of only five firms on the official list of the country's bourse.
Companies have had to operate in a tough market environment where credit is hard to come by or is only available at high rates.
Analysts say that the banking sector, which has recovered from a serious crisis, is gradually becoming more responsive to the needs of companies.
